messages:
riley: Hi team, airport parking charged to the corporate card last week but the merchant shows up as 'PARKIT UNKNOWN' on the statement. Guest asked for an itemized receipt; I don't have it. Charge $62.00 on 2026-04-02.

nate: can you attach the corpcard transaction screenshot? we need date, last4, and merchant line to file a merchant inquiry.

riley: attached screenshot in Ramp and uploaded to the card dispute portal. last4 1234, authorization 04/02. No invoice provided by vendor at the garage.

expenses-bot: For unknown-merchant charges we require either: 1) an itemized receipt from vendor, or 2) a statement from the employee with trip details plus manager approval to reimburse if vendor cannot produce a receipt. If a dispute is filed with the card issuer, refunds can take 7-10 business days.

finance_ops: Nate, please submit a merchant inquiry with our card provider and flag for chargeback if vendor can't provide receipt. Riley, please add a short note in Ramp: "Airport parking - vendor unable to provide itemized receipt. Manager Nate approves reimbursement if charge is validated." once that's in we'll either process or await bank response.

riley: done 123123 - added note and linked dispute case. Thanks, will follow up when bank responds.
